intro.title: useId & Stable IDs
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple form with multiple labels and input fields to understand how React's useId hook generates unique, stable IDs. You will learn the core concept of generating unique identifiers for accessibility and linking form elements without causing mismatches during server-side rendering or component re-renders. The main technologies involved are React functional components, the useId hook, and JSX for structuring the form. By the end, you'll be able to implement stable IDs to improve your app's accessibility and reliability.
intro.usecase: In real applications, stable IDs are essential for accessibility and form functionality. When building complex forms with multiple input fields, each label needs a unique ID that matches its corresponding input's `htmlFor` attribute. Without stable IDs, React's re-renders could cause mismatches between labels and inputs, breaking screen reader functionality and form validation. This pattern is critical in data-heavy interfaces like admin dashboards, multi-step wizards, and settings panels where form reliability directly impacts user experience.
